items.title: Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
items.description: Unauthenticated, remote attackers could write arbitrary files to the operating system and execute commands with root privileges. The post Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-0322 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of remote code execution in the management interface. items.title: Fake Chrome App on Google Play Evades Detection and Reaches 100,000+ Downloads
items.description: A fake Google Chrome app appeared on Google Play with a screenshot showing more than 100,000 downloads, raising fresh concerns about app checks and paid search results. The listing copied Chrome’s name, icon, and description, but its developer was Hizbartech rather than Google LLC. items.title: Multiple Active Directory Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Bypass Security Feature Remotely
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed three Active Directory vulnerabilities that could let a remote attacker bypass a key security feature in Windows domain environments. The issues are tracked as CVE-2026-69982, CVE-2026-96252, and CVE-2026-108131, and administrators should review Microsoft’s Security Update Guide entries and deploy the available fixes as soon as possible. items.title: Hackers Exploit Palo Alto PAN-OS 0-day Flaw to Gain Root Code Execution on Firewalls
items.description: Hackers are exploiting a high-severity flaw in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS that allows authenticated attackers to run code with root privileges on affected firewalls. Tracked as CVE-2026-0322, the vulnerability affects the management interface, with the company confirming “very limited exploitation” and urging customers to apply fixes as soon as possible. items.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway 0-Day Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Cisco has warned that attackers are actively exploiting a critical zero-day vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that can give them root access to affected appliances. Tracked as CVE-2026-76519, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 9.8 and allows attacks through specially crafted email attachments without requiring a login.
